verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an agent-building platform, but the pack never shows LiveKit's own AI generating or improving prompts, flows, or test cases from a description. Agent Builder is documented only as a no-code browser prototyping tool, and the LLM-driven simulated user runs and evaluates conversations rather than authoring tests. Support for external coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor is a user-side workaround, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's own AI helps me author agents — generating or improving prompts, flows, and test cases from a description
